103:3.text: إِلَّا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ وَعَمِلُواْ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ وَتَوَاصَوۡاْ بِٱلۡحَقِّ وَتَوَاصَوۡاْ بِٱلصَّبۡرِ
103:3.tr: Except for those who have believed and done righteous deeds and advised each other to truth and advised each other to patience.

105:1.text: أَلَمۡ تَرَ كَيۡفَ فَعَلَ رَبُّكَ بِأَصۡحَٰبِ ٱلۡفِيلِ
105:1.tr: Have you not considered, [O Muḥammad], how your Lord dealt with the companions of the elephant?
